caveats: The report contains only captured cases with completed copied worker artifacts; uncaptured matrix rows are omitted.
A device_total sample cannot attribute utilization, memory, or power exclusively to this simulation.
The first case journal wall_end_to_end_s includes later adoption/collection and differs from its exact SDK activation-to-completion duration.
An observer interval and terminal_stats.wall_time_ns have different clock boundaries and are reported independently.
These benchmark summaries do not establish scientific qualification, backend parity, or release qualification.
methodology: mean_native_s_per_accepted_solver_step = native_wall_time_s / metadata.json accepted_solver_steps; the count can include the initial state.
scalar_step_count = max(step)-min(step) from the copied scalars.csv, so the initial state is excluded from the delta.
scalar_steps_per_native_s = scalar_step_count / native_wall_time_s; this throughput includes callback costs and is not a standalone GPU-kernel rate.
Missing or zero GPU-kernel timing in terminal_stats is unmeasured and is emitted as null.
Telemetry files are parsed as concatenated JSON objects with JSONDecoder.raw_decode; valid measured records are retained even when the last record is not_measured.
GPU rows_csv is decoded as uuid, name, utilization percent, memory used MiB, total MiB, and power W. Device telemetry is scope=device_total and exclusive_to_case=false.
For the first bimeron +x case, exact SDK timestamps are retained separately; other journal wall_end_to_end_s values remain observer intervals and are not converted into SDK durations.

Only measured device_total samples timestamped within the selected exact SDK interval or recorded journal observer interval contribute to telemetry means; post-terminal samples remain in JSON/CSV and are excluded.
